/** * A basic implementation of the WurmServerMod interface. * *
This class serves as a simple mod template that can be extended * to create custom server-side modifications for Wurm Online/Unlimited. * It implements the core WurmServerMod interface which defines the * lifecycle methods for server mods. * *
Usage example: * * public class MyCustomMod extends SimpleMod { * // Override methods to implement custom behavior * } * * *
Lifecycle notes: * *
Mod initialization occurs during server startup *
All methods are called on the main server thread *
This implementation is thread-safe by default * * * @since 1.0.0 * @see WurmServerMod */
